2026-10-02.focus: Squatober Day 2 — Bending in a Polo
2026-10-02.notes: Back squat at 62% — belt off, all 32 reps identical with depth that leaves no doubt. 2 min rest between sets; 90 sec between Zercher sets, 60 sec between carries. Warm up: 5 jumping jacks + 5 pushups, repeat as needed. Recovery: extra meaty pot roast, 30 min walk, 8+ hrs sleep. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-04.notes: Rest day. Resting, walking and eating are high priority — there are still some things to actively do to stay on track with the plan. 5 days of strength training is on deck for week 2. Be ready. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-05.focus: Squatober Day 5 — Never Miss a Monday
2026-10-05.notes: 2 min rest between back squat sets; 2 1/2 min between bench sets; 2 min between row/lateral-raise superset rounds; 60 sec between warm-up carries and cardio sets. Increase weight each carry set. Bench burnout set at 85% — if you get 4 or less reps, lower your bench max 5%; 8 or more reps, raise it 3%. Slow the tempo on the pushups to make them more challenging. Recovery: sloppy joes and tator tots, 30 min walk, deep heavy sleep. — via @sorinex_squatober
